source: Appendix B, B.9 AI Contract Clause Checklist (docs/BOOK_TABLES.md)
intro: For contracts with suppliers of AI models, systems or services (Chapters 5 and 7). The clauses answer LEG-12, "Contracts that leave the organisation holding the vendor's risk", and the controls of A.10.2 and A.10.3.

clauses.covers: Advance notice of model or version changes; the right to pin a version; a deprecation timetable
Model card, evaluation results, known limits, instructions for use, and for general-purpose models the training-content summary
No training on your prompts, outputs or data without agreement; retention limits; deletion on exit
The right to run your own tests and to receive the supplier's test results and incident history
A notice period for incidents and malfunctions that is shorter than your own reporting deadlines; cooperation in investigations
Access to logs in a usable form, and the retention period
Disclosure of sub-processors and upstream model providers, and notice of changes
Allocation of liability; intellectual property indemnity; limits on caps for data and regulatory loss
Availability, latency, rate limits, support and fallback
Notice of price changes; spend caps; consumption alerts
Security standards, vulnerability disclosure, data location and transfer terms
Return of data, migration help, a transition period, and a right to terminate on regulatory change or material change to the model
The supplier's classification of the system, no prohibited practices, conformity and registration where required
Instructions, oversight tooling and an explanation capability
Performance results by group, and the supplier's bias testing method
Intended-use limits, prohibited uses, and the supplier's monitoring of misuse
Notice and termination rights if the supplier is acquired or changes its terms
